name: Harnepher
overview: Harnepher is a male member of the tribe of Asher, identified uniquely as the son of Zophah. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no additional information or notes about his life or character. His mention serves primarily to establish lineage within the tribe of Asher.
namesAndTitles: The name Harnepher means 'Horus is merciful,' reflecting an Egyptian influence in the meaning of his proper name. This name was not given by God but recorded in 1 Chronicles 7:36.
familyAndRelationships: Harnepher is explicitly recorded as the son of Zophah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Scripture does not provide any further family relationships beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Harnepher's significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Asher, as noted in 1 Chronicles 7:36. His mention helps to preserve the historical lineage of God's people, which is important for understanding the fulfillment of God's promises through the tribes of Israel. While not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion underscores the biblical emphasis on heritage and God's faithfulness to His covenant people.
